 If the latest speculations from Bollywood are believed, top music composer Anirudh has taken an exit from Shah Rukh Khan’s upcoming prestigious film King which is due for December release. Occupied with a lot of commitments and taking a wedding break, Anirudh has decided to walk out from the project. Sachin – Jigar have joined the project after Anirudh is out from the film.
 As a mark of respect for Shah Rukh Khan, Anirudh has composed the theme track of King. He had a series of discussions with Siddharth Anand and Shah Rukh Khan before he decided to take an exit from King. The makers are working round the clock to complete the post-production works on time. King is scheduled for December 24th release. Sachin – Jigar have started their work for King. The film features Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan in other lead roles. SRK and Siddharth Anand are jointly producing King.
